datasets.name: agenda-self-assignee
datasets.purpose: Create an agenda assigned to the signed-in user (Self Me)
datasets.uiFlow: Click Agendas (N) header → + Create New Agenda → Agenda titles → Self (Me) → + Create Agenda

datasets.name: agenda-external-assignee
datasets.purpose: Create an agenda assigned to an external person with name and email
datasets.uiFlow: Create New Agenda → External assignee → fill name + email → + Create Agenda

datasets.name: agenda-employee-assignee
datasets.purpose: Create an agenda assigned to another employee from the directory
datasets.uiFlow: Create New Agenda → Employee assignee → search and select → + Create Agenda

datasets.name: agenda-bulk-titles
datasets.purpose: Create multiple agendas from bulk title lines (one per line)
datasets.uiFlow: Create New Agenda → enter multiple titles → + Create Agenda

datasets.name: agenda-from-bucket

datasets.purpose: Cancel discards agenda create form without persisting
